subject: R Revolutions 3.2.2 within CentOS 7.1 tcltk issue

messages.author: f23ffc14fc724f84
messages.subject: R Revolutions 3.2.2 within CentOS 7.1 tcltk issue
parts:
I've installed R Revloutions 3.2.2 within CentOS 7.1 and I'm trying to install Rcmdr using install.packages("Rcmdr"). I'm getting error saying that tcltk is not supported on R 3.2.2 is that correct ?

Is there any workaround ?

messages.author: f23ffc14fc724f84
messages.subject: Re: R Revolutions 3.2.2 within CentOS 7.1 tcltk issue
parts:
Guys,

Here is what is happening. If I install R 3.2.2 using "yum instal R\*" is does works tcltk interface, but then I lose MKL libraries.
When I downloaded RRO-3.2.2 and RevoMaths (MKL) is does works mulththreading but then I lose tcltk package to work.

My guess R Revolutions may have forgotten to put tcktk parameter when they built RRO-3.2.2. 
I will try to download the source code and re-build RRO-3.2.2, but if someone that already did it and could share the compiled version I will appreciate that.

Thanks,

Wilson

messages.author: 9ca0345d553844f2
messages.subject: Re: R Revolutions 3.2.2 within CentOS 7.1 tcltk issue
parts:
Hi Wilson,

Looks like you found a defect. The library is in fact missing. The only workaround is to build it yourself for now. 
We hope to have a new release in about 6-8 weeks in which this would be remedied.

Cheers,
Josée

messages.author: f23ffc14fc724f84
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] Re: R Revolutions 3.2.2 within CentOS 7.1 tcltk issue
parts:
Hi Josée,

Thank you for your feedback, I downgraded till RRO3.2.0 which worked with TCLTK package. even RRO 3.2.1 is not working with the package.

I tried to re-compile myself but the MONO libraries with CentOS 7.1 is a lot of headache put in place due to CLR and other libraries.

Cheers,

Wilson
